reviews.comment:
Un desastre.
La atención: es un descontrol de autos por todos lados, nadie te indica por dónde ir.

Reparación:
Lleve mi auto a reparar la luz de guiño trasera y la del espejo. Cuando lo voy a retirar habían hecho la mitad del trabajo porque el guiño del espejo seguía sin funcionar. Cuando pido explicaciones de porque me había cobrado dos lamparitas cómo decía en la factura era que me había cambiado una que funcionaba.

Precio: me llamaron para comunicarme el presupuesto y saber si lo aceptaba o no. Cuando llegó al ACA para retirar el auto me indican que el precio era otro. Que lo que me habían pasado por teléfono era únicamente la mano de obra.

(Translated by Google)
A disaster.
The service: It's chaotic, with cars everywhere, and no one tells you where to go.

Repair: I took my car in to have the rear turn signal and mirror light repaired. When I went to pick it up, they had only done half the job because the mirror turn signal still wasn't working. When I asked why they had charged me for two bulbs, as the invoice stated, it turned out they had replaced one that was working.

Price: They called me to give me an estimate and ask if I would accept it. When I arrived at the ACA to pick up the car, they told me the price was different. What they had quoted me over the phone was only for labor.
